metadata.title: Refund and cancellation policy · Outvers
metadata.description: Outvers refund policy explained — Flexible, Moderate, Strict presets, refund SLA, vendor-cancelled bookings, and how to request a cashout from your wallet.

calculator.heading: See your exact refund before you book
calculator.description: Enter a booking total, pick the preset, and choose when you would cancel. We run the same refund calculation the money path uses — so the figure here is the figure you would get.
calculator.promptEmpty: Enter an amount and both dates to see your refund.
calculator.promptInvalid: Your cancellation is on or after the start time, so it falls outside the policy window and would open a support dispute rather than an automatic refund.
calculator.walletNoteBody: An eligible refund credits your Refund balance — the cash-returnable bucket of your two-bucket Wallet. You can spend it on a future booking or cash it out to your original payment method (5–7 working days). It is not Outvers credit, which is promotional and spendable on Outvers only.

hero.title: Refund and cancellation policy
hero.description: Every Outvers Experience has one of three named cancellation presets — Flexible, Moderate, or Strict. The preset is locked when you book and is shown on every Experience card, the checkout page, the confirmation email, and the WhatsApp confirmation. Refund math is a pure function of the preset, your cancellation timestamp, and the booking total. No human review inside the policy window.

examples.heading: Worked examples
examples.flexibleTitle: A short day trip — Rishikesh rafting at 9 AM Saturday
examples.flexibleBody: Cancel by Friday 9 AM → full refund. Cancel Friday 9 AM to Saturday 7 AM → 50% refund. After 7 AM Saturday → no refund.
examples.moderateTitle: A weekend trek starting Saturday 6 AM
examples.moderateBody: Cancel by Wednesday 6 AM → full refund. Cancel Wednesday 6 AM to Friday 6 AM → 50% refund. After Friday 6 AM → no refund.
examples.strictTitle: A multi-day Himalayan trek starting on the 20th
examples.strictBody: Cancel by the 6th → full refund. Cancel between the 6th and the 13th → 50% refund. After the 13th → no refund.

specialCases.heading: Special cases
specialCases.vendorCancelledBody: If a vendor cancels — weather, equipment failure, staffing — you receive a 100% refund regardless of preset. The vendor's response-time SLA score takes a hit.
specialCases.outsideWindowBody: If you cancel after the experience start time, the cancellation opens a dispute. Resolution is at admin discretion; declined by default except in clear vendor-fault cases.
specialCases.customPoliciesBody: A small number of high-altitude expeditions and festival-day experiences have a Custom policy with non-refundable permits or guide deposits. These are admin-approved at listing time and shown in plain language on the Experience page.

refundSla.heading: When you'll see the money
refundSla.body: Eligible refunds credit to your Outvers wallet within 24 hours of an inside-policy cancellation. The wallet balance is spendable on any future booking; you can request a cashout to your original payment method any time — Razorpay round-trips bank transfers in 5–7 working days.

questions.heading: Still have questions?
questions.body: Email {email} or use the in-app chat on any booking — disputes filed inside the policy window are resolved within 48 hours.

metadata.title: Safety and trust · Outvers
metadata.description: How Outvers builds trust: a three-tier KYC verification ladder for vendors, transparent cancellation presets with SLA-backed wallet refunds, partial pay, surfaced permit requirements, and a notification-based safety stack.

hero.title: Safety and trust at Outvers
hero.description: Outvers is an adventure marketplace, so trust is the product. We do not own the rafts, the harnesses, or the trails — independent vendors do. Our job is to verify who they are, make the money rules predictable, and notify the right people when something goes wrong. Some safety and verification features may vary by experience and vendor. Each Experience shows what is verified before you book. Where Outvers does not do something — like obtaining your permits or dispatching emergency services — we say so plainly.

kyc.heading: Every vendor climbs a three-tier verification ladder
kyc.intro: A vendor's KYC tier decides what they are allowed to list and transact. The badge on each Experience card tells you exactly how far a vendor has been verified — verification and responsiveness are tracked separately, so the badge is about identity, not popularity.
kyc.phoneBody: An OTP-confirmed phone number at signup. A Phone verified vendor can draft Experiences but cannot publish, accept bookings, or receive payouts. No badge appears on listings at this tier.
kyc.identityBody: Aadhaar eKYC plus a format-validated PAN, with at least one Experience reviewed by an admin. An Identity verified vendor may publish single-day Experiences up to Rs.5,000 per person and 8 participants per slot, and carries the "Identity verified" badge.
kyc.businessBody: Identity verification plus a recorded video-call check of premises and equipment, a GSTIN or a below-threshold self-declaration with Udyam registration, and the category-relevant guide certifications (for example ATOAI, RMI, NIM, or APPI). A Business verified vendor has unrestricted listing rights and carries the "Business verified" badge.

money.heading: The money rules are written down before you pay
money.cancellationTitle: Three cancellation presets, locked at booking
money.cancellationBody: Every Experience uses one of three named cancellation presets — Flexible, Moderate, or Strict. The preset is locked when you book and shown on the Experience card, the checkout page, and your confirmation. Refund math is a pure function of the preset, your cancellation time, and the booking total — no human review inside the policy window. Read the full breakdown on our cancellation policy page.
money.walletTitle: Two-bucket wallet — Outvers credit and Refund balance
money.walletBody: Your Wallet shows two separate buckets. Outvers credit is promotional balance from referrals and offers — spendable on Outvers bookings only. Refund balance is real money: an inside-policy cancellation auto-credits it within minutes, and you can cash it back to your original payment method via a 5–7 working-day Razorpay round-trip. A vendor-cancelled booking is always a full refund regardless of preset.
money.partialPayTitle: Partial pay — a 25% Advance now, the rest at T-24h
money.partialPayBody: For eligible bookings you pay a 25% Advance at booking time, and the remaining 75% is auto-captured 24 hours before the Experience starts. You see both figures before you commit, so there is no surprise charge.

onground.heading: On the ground: permits surfaced, safety notified
onground.permitsBody: Some Experiences sit in permit-gated areas (for example Inner Line Permits or wildlife-area entry). Outvers surfaces each required permit in plain language with a link to the official application and a mandatory acknowledgement before you book. To be clear: Outvers does not obtain permits on your behalf — we tell you exactly what you need and where to get it.
onground.safetyStackTitle: The safety stack: trusted contact, SOS, and check-in pings
onground.safetyStackBody: Experiences that need it — treks, paragliding, scuba, rafting, and high-flagged regions — turn on the safety stack. You record a trusted contact before booking. Where SOS is enabled for an Experience, triggering it notifies your trusted contact, the vendor, and Outvers ops; automated check-in pings ask "arrived safely?" at trip start and end where supported. Each listing shows which safety features apply before you book.
onground.postureTitle: A notification tool, not an emergency service
onground.postureBody: Outvers SOS notifies people; it does not dispatch emergency services and does not promise a response. In a life-threatening emergency, dial 112. If trip location sharing is enabled, routine location is visible only to you and is deleted after the trip ends — we keep no standing surveillance log.

contact.heading: Questions about safety?
contact.body: Email {email} and our team will help — we aim to resolve disputes filed inside the policy window within 48 hours.

metadata.title: About Outvers · India's adventure-activity marketplace
metadata.description: Outvers connects adventure-seeking customers across India with KYC-verified independent vendors — rafting operators, paragliding outfits, trekking companies, and more — with transparent pricing and refunds.

hero.title: About Outvers
hero.description: Outvers is an Indian adventure-activity marketplace. We connect customers who want to raft, trek, paraglide, dive, and explore with independent vendors who run those Experiences — verified, priced transparently, and bookable in a few taps.

mission.heading: Our mission
mission.body: India's adventure-activity market is enormous and fragmented — thousands of skilled local operators, most without an online storefront, and customers who struggle to tell a verified outfit from a risky one. Outvers exists to close that gap honestly: bring real operators online, verify who they are, and make the rules of money and safety predictable for everyone.

howItWorks.heading: How Outvers works
howItWorks.browseBody: Search single-day and multi-day Experiences across regions and activities. Pricing brackets, availability, and the cancellation preset are shown up front.
howItWorks.bookBody: Eligible bookings use partial pay — a 25% Advance now, the rest auto-captured 24 hours before you go. Refunds follow a fixed cancellation preset, never a case-by-case guess.
howItWorks.trustBody: Every vendor climbs a three-tier KYC ladder — Phone verified, Identity verified, Business verified — and the badge on each listing tells you how far they got. For higher-risk activities, a safety stack adds a trusted contact, with SOS notifications and check-in pings where enabled.

honesty.heading: What we are — and what we are not
honesty.body: Outvers is a marketplace. The Experiences are operated by independent third-party vendors, not by Outvers. We verify vendors, hold the money rules, and — where SOS is enabled — notify your contacts when you trigger it. But we do not run the trips ourselves, we do not obtain permits on your behalf, and our SOS is a notification tool, not an emergency response service. Being clear about this is part of the trust.

contact.body: Reach us at {email}. If you operate adventure Experiences and want to list them, start with vendor onboarding.

metadata.description: Answers to common questions about booking adventure Experiences on Outvers — Partial pay, the Cancellation policy presets, your two-bucket Wallet, KYC-verified Vendors, Required permits, and the Safety stack.

hero.title: How can we help?
hero.description: Answers to the questions Customers ask most — about booking, payments, refunds, your Wallet, Vendor verification, and safety on Outvers.

whatIsOutvers.question: What is Outvers?
whatIsOutvers.answer: Outvers is an Indian adventure-activity marketplace where you book Experiences — rafting, paragliding, treks and more — run by independent Vendors. Every Vendor is KYC-verified, every Experience shows a clear Cancellation policy, and slot availability is real-time so you only ever book a slot that still has room.

howToBook.question: How do I book an Experience?
howToBook.answer: Open the Experience page, pick an available slot and your participant count, then continue to checkout. Your per-person price follows the Group-size bracket (1-2, 3-5, or 6+) for your party. You confirm and pay with Razorpay; your Booking is confirmed the moment payment is captured.

partialPay.question: Do I have to pay the full amount upfront?
partialPay.answer: Most Bookings 48 hours or more away and up to Rs.25,000 default to Partial pay: Outvers captures a 25% Advance when you book, and the remaining 75% is auto-captured 24 hours before the Experience starts. The exact Advance and balance are shown on the checkout page before you pay.

cancellation.question: Can I cancel, and how much do I get back?
cancellation.answer: Each Experience uses one of three Cancellation policy presets — Flexible, Moderate, or Strict — chosen by the Vendor and locked onto your Booking when you book. How much is refundable depends on how far ahead of the start time you cancel. The exact figure is on the Experience page and in your booking confirmation, and you can preview it with the refund calculator on our cancellation policy page.

refundBalance.question: Where does my refund go, and can I get cash back?
refundBalance.answer: An inside-policy cancellation auto-credits your Refund balance with no human review, usually within 24-48 hours. Your Refund balance defaults to a Wallet credit you can spend on your next Booking, but it is cashable back to your original payment method on request — a 5-7 working-day Razorpay round-trip.

walletBuckets.question: What is the difference between Outvers credit and Refund balance?
walletBuckets.answer: Your Wallet holds two separate buckets. Outvers credit is promotional balance from referrals, festive promos and loyalty rewards — spendable only on Outvers Bookings and never cashable, and it expires 12-18 months after it is issued. Refund balance is your accrued refunds, which you can spend on Bookings or cash out to your bank.

vendorVerification.question: How do I know a Vendor is trustworthy?
vendorVerification.answer: Every Vendor passes KYC before they can transact. An Identity verified Vendor has cleared Aadhaar and PAN checks; a Business verified Vendor has additionally cleared a video call, GSTIN or self-declaration, and category-relevant guide certifications. Each Vendor's verification badge and Response-time SLA score are shown on their profile.

permits.question: Do I need a permit for some Experiences?
permits.answer: Some Experiences are permit-gated and need a Required permit — for example an Inner Line Permit or a wildlife-area entry. Outvers surfaces the requirement on the Experience page and links you to the official process. In v1 you obtain the permit yourself; Outvers does not obtain permits on your behalf.

safetyStack.question: What safety features does Outvers offer?
safetyStack.answer: Experiences flagged for it use the Safety stack: a Trusted contact you record before booking, plus — where enabled — automated check-in pings at trip start and end, an SOS button, and ephemeral live-location sharing. On an SOS trigger, Outvers notifies your Trusted contact, the Vendor, and Outvers ops — Outvers notifies, it does not dispatch.

metadata.title: List your adventure business on Outvers · Become a Vendor
metadata.description: List your adventure-activity business on Outvers — India's marketplace for verified Experiences. Take online Bookings, earn a Verified Vendor badge, track Payouts, and reach adventure-seeking customers. Start Vendor onboarding.

hero.title: List your adventure business on Outvers
hero.description: Outvers is India's marketplace for verified adventure Experiences. Bring your rafting, trekking, paragliding, or diving business online, take Bookings from customers across the country, and get paid reliably — with the trust of a verified Vendor profile behind every listing.

benefits.heading: Why list on Outvers
benefits.onlineBookingsBody: Customers discover, book, and pay for your Experiences on Outvers — with partial pay (a 25% Advance now, the rest auto-captured 24 hours before the activity) handled for you.
benefits.verifiedBadgeBody: Climb the KYC ladder and display an "Identity verified" or "Business verified" badge on every Experience card — the trust signal that converts browsers into bookings.
benefits.dashboardBody: Manage listings, availability, Bookings, and customer messages from a single Vendor dashboard built for adventure businesses.
benefits.payoutTrackingBody: See exactly what you've earned and when each Payout lands. Outvers handles GST and TDS on your behalf so the math is never a guess.
benefits.visibilityBody: Your Experiences surface in destination, activity, and search pages optimised for the customers already looking for what you offer.

whoCanJoin.heading: Who can join
whoCanJoin.intro: Outvers is for independent adventure-activity Vendors running real Experiences in India:
whoCanJoin.raftingBody: River-rafting Vendors with certified guides and the permits their stretch requires.
whoCanJoin.trekkingBody: Single-day and multi-day trek Vendors, from day hikes to high-altitude expeditions.
whoCanJoin.paraglidingBody: Tandem and solo paragliding Vendors with APPI-rated pilots.
whoCanJoin.divingBody: Scuba, snorkelling, and water-sports Vendors at India's coastal destinations.

documents.heading: Documents required, by verification tier
documents.intro: Outvers verifies Vendors on a three-tier KYC ladder (ADR-0007). You start listing at Tier 1 and unlock more as you verify. Plus, bank details are required for Payouts at every tier that can earn.
documents.phoneDocs: A phone number confirmed by OTP at signup. That's it — automatic when you register.
documents.phoneCan: Create your Vendor profile and draft Experiences (saved unpublished).
documents.phoneCannot: Cannot publish, accept Bookings, or receive Payouts yet. No badge.
documents.identityDocs: Aadhaar verified by OTP (UIDAI eKYC), PAN submitted and validated, at least one Experience submitted for admin review, and bank details for Payouts.
documents.identityCan: Publish within caps (single-day Experiences, up to ₹5,000 per person, up to 8 participants per slot), accept Bookings, and receive Payouts.
documents.identityCannot: No Combo Experiences and no multi-day treks until Tier 3.
documents.businessDocs: Everything in Tier 2, plus a GSTIN (if your declared turnover is ₹20L or more) or a below-threshold self-declaration with Udyam Aadhaar registration, plus at least one guide-certification document (ATOAI / RMI / NIM) for any adventure category that requires it.
documents.businessCan: Unrestricted listing — multi-day Experiences, Combos, any ticket size, any participant count.
documents.businessCannot: Unlocked after a 30-minute recorded video-call verification with our team.

verification.heading: How verification works
verification.intro: Each tier has one clear gate. You're never left guessing what's next.
verification.phoneStep: Sign up and confirm your phone by OTP. You can immediately create your Vendor profile and draft Experiences.
verification.identityStep: Verify your identity with Aadhaar OTP and a validated PAN, then submit your first Experience for admin review to publish and start earning.
verification.businessStep: Complete a 30-minute recorded video call with our team, submit GSTIN or Udyam registration, and upload any required guide certifications to unlock unrestricted listing.

bookingPayout.heading: How Bookings and Payouts work
bookingPayout.bookingTitle: Customers book and pay on Outvers
bookingPayout.bookingBody: Customers browse your Experiences, choose a slot, and pay securely. You confirm the Booking from your dashboard.
bookingPayout.partialPayBody: Eligible Bookings collect a 25% Advance up front; the remaining 75% is auto-captured 24 hours before the activity — no chasing balances.
bookingPayout.payoutBody: Once an Experience is delivered, your earnings are paid out to your registered bank account. Outvers handles GST and TDS so the Payout amount is always clear.

finalCta.heading: Ready to list your adventure business?
finalCta.body: Create your Vendor profile in minutes and start drafting Experiences today.

metadata.title: Terms of Service · Outvers
metadata.description: The terms governing your use of Outvers — a marketplace connecting Customers with independent third-party Vendors who run adventure Experiences across India.

hero.title: Terms of Service
hero.updated: These terms are a working draft.
hero.intro: These Terms of Service govern your access to and use of Outvers. By creating an account, browsing, or making a Booking, you agree to these terms.

TermsPage.reviewNotice: Working draft — pending final legal review. This document reflects how Outvers actually operates today, but the final wording is being reviewed by counsel before launch and may change.

marketplace.heading: Outvers is a marketplace, not the provider of Experiences
marketplace.body: Outvers operates an online marketplace that connects Customers with independent third-party Vendors. The adventure Experiences listed on Outvers — rafting, trekking, paragliding, diving and more — are owned, run and delivered by those Vendors, who are independent businesses, not employees or agents of Outvers. Outvers acts as an intermediary that lists Experiences, takes Bookings and processes payments on the Vendor's behalf. Outvers does not itself operate any Experience.
marketplace.vendorResponsibility: Each Vendor is responsible for the safety, quality, accuracy and lawful conduct of its own Experiences, including holding the licences, certifications and insurance its activity requires. Outvers verifies Vendors through a tiered KYC process (Phone verified, Identity verified, Business verified) but does not guarantee any Vendor's conduct or the outcome of any Experience.

accounts.heading: Your account
accounts.body: You must provide accurate information when you register and keep your account credentials secure. You are responsible for activity under your account. You must be legally able to enter into a contract to make a Booking, and you must meet any age, fitness or eligibility requirements an Experience states.

bookings.heading: Bookings and payment
bookings.body: When you make a Booking you enter into a contract with the Vendor for that Experience; Outvers facilitates that contract and the payment. Outvers uses a partial-pay model: by default a 25% Advance is captured at the time of Booking and the remaining 75% is captured automatically 24 hours before the Experience starts. For Experiences starting within 48 hours, or priced above ₹25,000, the full amount is captured upfront. Prices shown include applicable taxes as displayed at checkout.

cancellations.heading: Cancellations and refunds
cancellations.body: Each Experience carries one of three cancellation presets — Flexible, Moderate or Strict — chosen by the Vendor and locked at the time of Booking. Inside-policy cancellations are refunded automatically; outside-policy requests are reviewed as a Dispute. If a Vendor cancels your Booking, you always receive a full refund. The full schedule, an interactive calculator and refund timing are on our refund and cancellation page.

permits.heading: Permits and eligibility
permits.body: Some Experiences require a permit — for example certain high-altitude treks or protected areas. Where a permit is required, Outvers surfaces the requirement and links to the official process, but you are responsible for obtaining the required permit yourself. Outvers is not a permit broker and does not obtain permits on your behalf.

conduct.heading: Acceptable use
conduct.body: You agree not to misuse the platform, post unlawful or misleading content, attempt to circumvent payment, or interfere with other users. We may suspend or remove access for conduct that breaches these terms or applicable law.

liability.heading: Liability
liability.body: Adventure activities carry inherent risks. Because Experiences are run by independent third-party Vendors, your contract for the activity itself is with the Vendor. To the extent permitted by law, Outvers is not liable for the acts, omissions or outcomes of any Vendor or Experience. Nothing in these terms limits any liability that cannot lawfully be limited.

changes.heading: Changes and governing law
changes.body: We may update these terms from time to time; material changes will be notified on the platform. These terms are governed by the laws of India, and disputes are subject to the jurisdiction of the courts at the seat stated in our final published terms.

contact.heading: Contact
contact.body: Questions about these terms? Email support@outvers.com.

metadata.title: Privacy Policy · Outvers
metadata.description: How Outvers collects, uses and protects your personal data as a marketplace connecting Customers with independent third-party Vendors.

hero.title: Privacy Policy
hero.intro: This policy explains what personal data Outvers collects, why we collect it, how we use it, and the choices you have.

PrivacyPage.reviewNotice: Working draft — pending final legal review. This document reflects how Outvers actually handles data today, but the final wording is being reviewed by counsel before launch and may change.

collect.heading: Personal data we collect
collect.body: We collect the personal information you give us when you create an account, make a Booking, contact support or subscribe to updates — such as your name, email, phone number and Booking details. We collect payment information through our payment processor (Razorpay); Outvers does not store full card details. We also collect technical data such as device, browser and usage information to operate and improve the service.

use.heading: How we use your data
use.body: We use your personal data to take and manage Bookings, process payments and refunds to your Wallet, communicate with you, provide support, keep the marketplace safe, comply with legal and tax obligations, and improve our Experiences and platform.

sharing.heading: When we share data
sharing.body: Because Experiences are run by independent third-party Vendors, we share the Booking details a Vendor needs to deliver your Experience with the relevant Vendor. We share data with service providers who work on our behalf — for example our payment processor and search and hosting providers — and with authorities where the law requires it. We do not sell your personal data.

retention.heading: Retention
retention.body: We keep personal data for as long as your account is active and as long as needed to provide the service, resolve Disputes, and meet legal, accounting and tax requirements (including TDS and GST records).

rights.heading: Your choices and rights
rights.body: You can access and update your account information at any time, unsubscribe from marketing emails, and request deletion of your account subject to records we must retain by law. To exercise these rights, contact us.

security.heading: Security
security.body: We use technical and organisational measures to protect your personal data. No system is perfectly secure, so we cannot promise absolute security, but we work to safeguard your information and to notify you of material incidents where required.

contact.heading: Contact
contact.body: Privacy questions or requests? Email support@outvers.com.

metadata.title: Refund & Cancellation Policy · Outvers
metadata.description: How cancellations and refunds work on Outvers — Flexible, Moderate and Strict presets, refund timing to your Refund balance, and bank cashout via Razorpay.

hero.title: Refund & Cancellation Policy
hero.intro: Every Experience carries a cancellation preset chosen by the Vendor and locked when you book. This page explains the presets, what you get back, and when.

RefundCancellationPage.reviewNotice: Working draft — pending final legal review. This summary reflects how cancellations and refunds actually work on Outvers today, but the final wording is being reviewed by counsel before launch and may change.

presets.heading: The three cancellation presets
presets.intro: Each Experience uses one of three presets. The preset is shown on the Experience before you book and is locked at the time of Booking. Windows are measured against the Experience start time.

insidePolicy.heading: Inside-policy cancellations
insidePolicy.body: When you cancel within your Experience's preset window, the eligible amount is credited automatically to your Outvers Wallet (your Refund balance) — there's nothing to claim; see the refund timing below.

vendorCancelled.heading: If the Vendor cancels
vendorCancelled.body: If a Vendor cancels your Booking, you always receive a full refund regardless of the preset. Weather or safety stand-downs called by the Vendor are treated as a Vendor cancellation and refunded in full.

outsidePolicy.heading: Outside-policy requests, no-shows and Disputes
outsidePolicy.body: Cancellation requests outside your preset window — and no-shows — are routed to our support team as a Dispute. These are declined by default, but we review clear cases of Vendor fault and decide case by case.

refundSla.heading: When you'll see the money
refundSla.body: Refunds are credited to your Outvers Wallet (your Refund balance) within 24–48 hours of an inside-policy cancellation. Your Refund balance is spendable on any future Booking; if you prefer, you can request a cashout to your original payment method, which Razorpay round-trips to your bank in 5–7 working days. The 24–48 hour window is when your Wallet is credited — the 5–7 working days applies only if you choose the bank cashout.

policyLink.label: See the full policy and refund calculator
policyLink.body: Our cancellation policy page has the complete reference and an interactive calculator that quotes your exact refund before you book.

contact.heading: Questions
contact.body: Need help with a refund? Email support@outvers.com.

metadata.title: Vendor Terms · Outvers
metadata.description: Terms for independent third-party Vendors on Outvers — KYC verification tiers, Commission, Payout flow, TDS and GST, and cancellation obligations.

hero.title: Vendor Terms
hero.intro: These terms apply to independent third-party Vendors who list and run Experiences on the Outvers marketplace.

VendorTermsPage.reviewNotice: Working draft — pending final legal review. This document reflects how Vendor onboarding, Payouts and tax actually work on Outvers today, but the final wording is being reviewed by counsel before launch and may change.

relationship.heading: Your relationship with Outvers
relationship.body: As a Vendor you are an independent business listing your own Experiences on the Outvers marketplace. You — not Outvers — own, operate and deliver your Experiences and are responsible for their safety, quality, legality, and for holding the licences, certifications and insurance your activity requires. Outvers is an intermediary that lists your Experiences, takes Bookings and processes payments on your behalf.

kyc.heading: Verification (KYC) tiers
kyc.intro: Vendors are verified in three tiers. Higher tiers unlock listing badges and broader catalogue access.
kyc.phone: Phone verified — phone OTP at signup.
kyc.identity: Identity verified — Aadhaar and PAN verified; earns the "Identity verified" badge.
kyc.business: Business verified — GSTIN or Udyam plus a guide certificate and a video call; earns the "Business verified" badge.

commission.heading: Commission
commission.body: Outvers charges a Commission on each completed Booking. The Commission is deducted from your Payout and is realised at the Completion of the Experience, not at the time of Booking. GST applies to the Commission and is shown on your invoice.

payout.heading: Payouts
payout.body: A Payout is the money Outvers transfers to you for a completed Experience, net of Commission, GST on the Commission, and TDS. Payouts are issued T+7 from Booking Completion in daily batches. A Payout may be paused while a Dispute on the related Booking is open. You must keep accurate bank details on file to receive Payouts.

tax.heading: TDS and GST
tax.body: Under Section 194-O, Outvers withholds TDS at 0.1% on the gross Booking value for resident-Indian Vendors. We file Form 26Q quarterly and issue you Form 16A. GST is applied to the Commission. You remain responsible for your own tax registration and filings.

cancellation.heading: Cancellations and service levels
cancellation.body: Each Experience carries a cancellation preset (Flexible, Moderate or Strict) locked at the time of Booking. If you cancel a confirmed Booking, the Customer always receives a full refund and your response-time SLA score is affected. We track your response time and reliability; persistently low scores can limit your visibility or listing access.

contact.heading: Contact
contact.body: Questions about Vendor terms? Email support@outvers.com.
